rules.sentence: CHD can be subdivided in non-cyanotic CHD and cyanotic CHD which is also called critical congenital heart disease (CCHD).
CCHD can be further classified into 3 different types of lesions: right heart obstructive lesions, left heart obstructive lesions, and mixing lesions.
This activity reviews the workup of cyanotic heart disease and describes the role of health professionals working together to manage this condition.
